title: ToolExecutionReceipt
description: Compact O(1) semantic receipt replacing raw tool outputs in message history, preventing O(N^2) trajectory compounding.

action.description: Tool name executed (view_file, run_command, grep_search, etc.)

summary.description: Dense, single-sentence summary of the execution outcome (< 30 words)

symbolsFound.description: Key symbols, exports, or functions extracted

receiptRef.description: Path to the raw content-addressable log on disk (.agent_execution/receipts/<hash>.log)
